Class ScoutSquad

java.lang.Object
ScoutSquad
public class ScoutSquad extends Object
Represents an elite combat squad within the Survey Corps (e.g. Squad Levi, Squad Hange). Uses varargs constructors and encapsulates squad readiness logic.
Author:
Survey Corps HQ

    • ScoutSquad

      public ScoutSquad(String leader)
      Constructor 1 (Overloaded): Creates a squad with only the leader. Calls the second constructor using this(...): 
          // Hint: Constructor delegation allows calling another constructor in the same class:
    // e.g., this(param1, defaultValueForParam2);
      (Calling one constructor from another in the same class using this(...) is known as constructor delegation).
      Parameters:
      leader - squad leader's name

    • ScoutSquad

      public ScoutSquad(String leader, String... members)
      Constructor 2 (Varargs Overloaded): Assembles a squad with a leader and arbitrary members. Computes squadPower as members.length * 50 + 100. Squad is not deployed initially (deployed is set to false).
      Parameters:
      leader - squad leader's name
      members - additional squad members (varargs)

    • canEngage

      public boolean canEngage(TitanShifter titan)
      Determines whether this squad has sufficient combat power to engage a specified titan. Checks if the titan is hostile and squadPower is greater than or equal to the titan's powerLevel.
      Parameters:
      titan - target TitanShifter
      Returns:
      true if squad can engage and neutralize the titan, false otherwise

    • reverseDistressSignal

      public static String reverseDistressSignal(String rawSignal)
      Decodes an inverted distress signal broadcast by scouts during titan ambush. Reverses the order of words in the transmission string. Words should be separated by a single space with no leading or trailing spaces.
      Useful String methods hint:
      • " hello world ".trim() → "hello world"
      • "hello world".split("\\s+") → new String[]{"hello", "world"}
      Example: "advance towards the forest" -> "forest the towards advance" Example: " breach at wall rose " -> "rose wall at breach"
      Parameters:
      rawSignal - original distress transmission string
      Returns:
      decoded signal with words in reversed order separated by a single space
